name: two-motion-arm
prompt: Make a bar 0.1 m thick and 0.8 m long that pivots about its lower end. It has two separate motions: a wave (swing 50 degrees sideways over one second) and a reach (tilt 70 degrees forward over two seconds). Add two small buttons, each 0.1 m: one runs only the wave, the other only the reach, and each leaves the other motion where it was.

name: dance-sequence
prompt: Make a 0.2 m cube that does a little dance when clicked: first it slides 1 m to the right in half a second, then it hops up 1 m in half a second, then it moves 1 m forward in half a second, one after the other. Clicking again does the dance again.
